de.content:
Globe is seeing strong growth in skateboarding shoes this year as interest in ’90s skate styles continues to return.

RELATED: Mark Appleyard Honored by Globe for 21 Years of Loyalty and Commitment

According to reports, CEO Matt Hill says the brand’s heritage footwear has grown steadily over the past few years.

At the same time, newer skate and lifestyle shoes are performing just as well.

That has helped Globe grow across core retailers, mainstream stores and its direct to consumer business.
